RESPONSIVE DECLARATION TO ORDER SHOW CAUSE (DOMESTIC VIOLENCE PREVENTION) FILED BY PERSON TO BE RESTRAINED JACKSON, PETER R
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE TEMPORARY JUDGE

PETITIONER IN PRO PER. RESPONDENT IN PRO PER. PARTIES SIGNED STIPULATION FOR PRO TEM JUDGE. PARTIES WERE PLACED UNDER OATH & TESTIFIED. PETITIONER SUBMITTED AN SAN FRANCISCO POLICE DEPARTMENT INCIDENT TO THE COURT FOR REVIEW. AFTER ARGUMENT BY THE PARTIES, THE COURT DENIED PETITIONER'S REQUEST FOR A R/O. ADDITIONALLY, THE COURT RULED THAT IT DID NOT HAVE JURISDICTION TO COMPEL RESPONDENT TO CONTINUE TO MAKE MORTGAGE PAYMENTS ON THE JOINT RESIDENCE. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY BELDON YEE, CSR #2647.
